props.title: Contributions — FOSS, open specs & technical experiments

props.items:
shield :: Vera Trust Stack (@verared/* — Apache-2.0) :: 7 standalone npm packages (net, apw, local-trust, reputation, trust-layer, cloud-images, identity-atproto) for cryptographic agent verification and local trust policies. :: span=2 :: featured
package :: Portaless Plugin SDK (MIT) :: Minimal, stable SDK surface for third-party plugins without touching core internals.
book :: Vera Trust Spec (CC BY 4.0) :: Open specification for Protocol APW, Local Trust Protocol, SVRI, and HSVR with verifiable test vectors.
server :: Portaless & Templates (AGPL-3.0 / CC0-1.0) :: Astro CMS engine with Visual Elements, ThemePack v2 dual-mode, strict CSP (A-07), and public reusable templates. :: span=2 :: featured

bot :: MCP agent experiments :: Local tool servers with atomic capability checks and reproducible audit logs.
package :: [Editable] Side-project or upstream PR :: Ready-to-edit slot for third-party PRs, small utilities, and weekend CLI tools.
